Call B: Data infrastructure for crop research (example)

The Example Funder invites proposals for research data infrastructure that serves crop research communities. Projects should make genomic, phenotypic and environmental data findable, accessible, interoperable and reusable, and should be built together with the researchers who will use them.

Who can apply

Universities and non-university research institutes in Germany can apply, alone or as a consortium. Partners from other countries can take part if they bring their own funding. Companies can join as associated partners without funding.

Funding

Projects receive up to EUR 1.5 million for up to four years. Funding covers staff, equipment, travel and the costs of making data openly available after the project ends. Proposals that reuse existing infrastructure are especially welcome.

Deadlines

Sketches are due on 15 March 2027. Selected applicants will be invited to submit a full proposal by 30 June 2027. Decisions are expected in December 2027.

How to apply

Submit your sketch through the online portal. The sketch should not exceed five pages and must include a work plan, a data management outline and a short description of the user community. Late or incomplete sketches cannot be considered.

Review

An international panel reviews the sketches. It looks at the scientific quality of the plan, how well the infrastructure meets the needs of its users, how the data will stay available after the funding ends, and whether the team has the skills to run a service for others. Applicants receive written feedback whether or not they are invited to the second stage.
